next:or:183.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:183.hint: OとCが能動の関係になる使役表現
next:or:183.question: I [[had him cleaned]] the room.
next:or:183.fullSentence: I had him clean the room.
next:or:183.explanation: 使役+O+do『Oが〜する』(能動的、OとCが能動の関係)。
next:or:183.relatedInfo: 使役+O+V-pp『Oが〜される』(受身的、OとCが受動の関係)との対比。

next:or:184.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:184.hint: 彼女は髪を切ってもらった(切らせた)
next:or:184.explanation: have+O+過去分詞『Oを〜してもらう』(受身的、OとCが受動の関係)。
next:or:184.relatedInfo: She had him cut her hair.(能動)との違いに注意。

next:or:185.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:185.hint: 強制的な使役を表す表現
next:or:185.question: Please explain it slowly to [[make me to understand]].
next:or:185.fullSentence: Please explain it slowly to make me understand.
next:or:185.explanation: make+O+do(原形)『Oに〜させる』(強制的な使役)。
next:or:185.relatedInfo: make oneself understood(受動)との対比。

next:or:186.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:186.hint: 彼は騒音の中でも自分の声が届くように大声で叫んだ
next:or:186.fullSentence: He shouted loudly to make himself heard over the noise.
next:or:186.explanation: make oneself heard『自分の声を届かせる(聞こえるようにする)』。make+O+過去分詞。
next:or:186.relatedInfo: make oneself understood『自分の言うことをわからせる』も同じ形。

next:or:187.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:187.hint: 意味上の主語が主節と異なる独立分詞構文
next:or:187.question: [[Being the holiday season]], the train was full.
next:or:187.fullSentence: It being the holiday season, the train was full.
next:or:187.explanation: 独立分詞構文: 意味上の主語(It)が主節の主語と異なる場合、分詞の前にその主語を置く。
next:or:187.relatedInfo: Because it was the holiday season, ~ と書き換え可能。

next:or:188.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:188.hint: 彼の年齢を考慮すると、彼はとても活発だ
next:or:188.fullSentence: Considering his age, he is very active.
next:or:188.explanation: considering=〜を考慮すると。慣用的独立分詞構文の一つ。

next:or:189.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:189.hint: 仮定・考慮を表す慣用的分詞構文
next:or:189.question: [[Giving that]] he is a beginner, he did well.
next:or:189.fullSentence: Given that he is a beginner, he did well.
next:or:189.explanation: given/granted=〜と仮定すると、〜を考慮すると。

next:or:190.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:190.hint: そうは言ったものの、私はまだ挑戦すべきだと思う
next:or:190.fullSentence: Having said that, I still think we should try.
next:or:190.explanation: having said that=そうは言うものの。慣用的独立分詞構文。

next:or:191.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:191.hint: 天候を条件とする慣用的独立分詞構文
next:or:191.question: [[Weather permitted]], we will go on a picnic tomorrow.
next:or:191.fullSentence: Weather permitting, we will go on a picnic tomorrow.
next:or:191.explanation: weather permitting=天候が許せば。慣用的独立分詞構文。
next:or:191.relatedInfo: If the weather permits, ~ と書き換え可能。

next:or:192.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:192.hint: すべてを考慮すると、それは良い決断だった
next:or:192.fullSentence: All things considered, it was a good decision.
next:or:192.explanation: all things considered=すべてを考慮すると。
next:or:192.relatedInfo: 文頭でよく使われる慣用的分詞構文。

next:or:193.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:193.hint: 事情がそうであることを表す独立分詞構文
next:or:193.question: [[That is the case]], we need a new plan.
next:or:193.fullSentence: That being the case, we need a new plan.
next:or:193.explanation: that/this/such being the case=そういうわけで(そんな事情なので)。
next:or:193.relatedInfo: Since that is the case, ~ と書き換え可能。

next:or:194.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:194.hint: 一般的に言って、女性は男性より長生きだ
next:or:194.fullSentence: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
next:or:194.explanation: generally speaking=一般的に言えば。分詞構文の意味を明確にする慣用副詞句。

next:or:195.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:195.hint: 遠慮せず本音を言うことを表す慣用副詞句
next:or:195.question: [[Frank speaking]], I don't like his attitude.
next:or:195.fullSentence: Frankly speaking, I don't like his attitude.
next:or:195.relatedInfo: to be frank with you とほぼ同義。

next:or:196.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:196.hint: 厳密に言うと、トマトは果物だ
next:or:196.fullSentence: Strictly speaking, a tomato is a fruit.
next:or:196.relatedInfo: 一般的な認識とは異なる事実を述べるときによく使う。

next:or:197.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:197.hint: 根拠から推測することを表す分詞構文
next:or:197.question: [[Judged from]] her accent, she is from Kansai.
next:or:197.fullSentence: Judging from her accent, she is from Kansai.
next:or:197.explanation: judging from A=Aから判断すると。

next:or:198.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:198.hint: 映画と言えば、新作を見た?
next:or:198.fullSentence: Speaking of movies, have you seen the new one?
next:or:198.relatedInfo: 話題を変えるときの慣用表現。

next:or:199.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:199.hint: 付帯状況を表すwith+名詞+分詞
next:or:199.question: He lay on the sofa [[with his arms folding]].
next:or:199.fullSentence: He lay on the sofa with his arms folded.
next:or:199.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞『〜が…された状態で』。
next:or:199.relatedInfo: 腕は「組まれる」ものなので過去分詞foldedを使う。

next:or:200.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:200.hint: あなたがそこに立っていては歌を歌えない
next:or:200.fullSentence: I can't sing a song with you standing there.
next:or:200.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+現在分詞『〜が…している状態で』。
next:or:200.relatedInfo: standは能動的な動作なので現在分詞standingを使う。

next:or:201.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:201.hint: 完了形の受動分詞構文(beingの省略)
next:or:201.question: [[Having wrote]] in easy English, this book is easy to read.
next:or:201.fullSentence: Having written in easy English, this book is easy to read.
next:or:201.explanation: 完了形の受動分詞構文(Having been written→beingは省略可)。
next:or:201.relatedInfo: Having been written と同じ意味。

next:or:202.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:202.hint: 宿題を終えたので、私は寝た
next:or:202.fullSentence: Having finished my homework, I went to bed.
next:or:202.explanation: 完了分詞構文(Having+Vpp)。主節の時制より前の出来事を表す。
next:or:202.relatedInfo: Finishing my homeworkだと主節と同時になってしまう。

next:or:203.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:203.hint: There is構文の独立分詞構文
next:or:203.question: [[Being no bus there]], I had to walk.
next:or:203.fullSentence: There being no bus, I had to walk.
next:or:203.explanation: There is構文の独立分詞構文。
next:or:203.relatedInfo: Because there was no bus, ~ と書き換え可能。

next:or:204.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:204.hint: 会社はその結果を公表することにした
next:or:204.fullSentence: The company decided to make the results known.
next:or:204.explanation: make O known『Oを知らせる、公表する』。make+O+過去分詞(既知の状態にする)の語法。
next:or:204.relatedInfo: make oneself understoodと同じmake+O+過去分詞のパターン。

next:or:205.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:205.hint: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞
next:or:205.question: He was sitting [[with his arms folding]].
next:or:205.fullSentence: He was sitting with his arms folded.
next:or:205.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞の練習例文。
next:or:205.relatedInfo: 腕は「組まれる」受動関係なのでfoldedを使う。

next:or:206.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:206.fullSentence: He was sitting with his legs crossed.
next:or:206.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+過去分詞。
next:or:206.relatedInfo: 脚は「組まれる」受動関係なのでcrossedを使う。

next:or:207.cat: 不定詞・動名詞・分詞
next:or:207.hint: 体の一部の位置を示す付帯状況表現
next:or:207.question: He was sitting [[with his chin at his hands]].
next:or:207.answer: with his chin on his hands
next:or:207.fullSentence: He was sitting with his chin on his hands.
next:or:207.wrongPart: with his chin at his hands
next:or:207.explanation: 付帯状況のwith+名詞+前置詞句。
next:or:207.relatedInfo: 分詞ではなく前置詞句が続く付帯状況の形もある。
